source_binding: The fixture, test, CMake registration and Qt workflow wiring were committed before the final local builds and regressions; this validation file is a documentation follow-up. The working tree was clean at the start of verification, and the recorded source hashes are the committed (LF) blob contents.
scope: One fixed 75 B ASCII hidden-frame scenario through the formal Qt / fixed-ConPTY path: real child primary body at 91x20, public Qt width shrink to 61, alternate-screen entry, height-only 20->14->20 changes, 1049l return at 61, and width restore to 91. Checks retained source body, owner/line identity, history prefix, display page, display caret and hit mapping; the child native grid is recorded separately and is not the retained-body oracle.

environment.configuration: Release, Visual Studio 17 2022, offscreen, owned Job

dependencies.preparation: Prepared dependency tree reused from the just-merged #313 verification slice; the pinned input manifests, archive identities and SDK tree identity are recorded below. CI prepares the same inputs independently.

commands.core_regression: cmake --build build --config Release --parallel 4 && ctest --test-dir build -C Release -R '^(.*_core|core|resize_replay_contract|recovery|keyboard)$' --output-on-failure

core_ctest.includes: every *_core native check, core, keyboard, recovery and resize_replay_contract

limitations: Offscreen local evidence only: not physical presentation, not a presented-frame endpoint (presented_done=null), not real 96/144 DPI, not native IME, not a physical keyboard or performance measurement.

One fixed 75 B ASCII sample and the literal 91x20 -> 61x20 -> 61x14 -> 61x20 -> 61x20 -> 91x20 sequence; no other sizes, continuous output, wide/Unicode/combining text, saved-cursor cross, history eviction limit, selection/copy/Find/history user flow or complete TUI.

The child native grid and selected native rows are recorded as a separate transport observation; they are not the oracle for the user-confirmed retained body, and no native grid equivalence is claimed.

The original WindTerm hidden-height observation, its preserved strict audit failure, the offline supplement and semantic_acceptance=false are unchanged; this product evidence does not reclassify them or remove the confirmed intentional difference.
The formal-path scenario does not close #27/#29/#30/#7, does not claim complete resize/reflow or WindTerm equivalence, and does not change the default Screen::resize physical-clipping behavior.
The local build reused the just-merged #313 prepared dependency tree identity; the Qt workflow prepares the same pinned manifests independently on CI.
